component.name: Nether
component.summary: Markdown notes with databases, offline first

description.p: Nether keeps your notes as plain Markdown files in a folder you choose, such as an Obsidian vault, and works with no account and no server.

ul.li: A block editor that writes Markdown, with math, code and diagrams
Links, backlinks, tags and properties, and pages within pages
Templates, daily notes, search, export and a trash
